message: As a grandparent, I've learned that storms can really turn a calm household into a whirlwind of excitement (or chaos) for the little ones. I came across a handy resource that lays out some practical tips for hurricane preparedness. It’s a simple way to keep the kiddos entertained while also making sure we’re all ready, just in case. Remember, it’s all about striking that balance between fun and safety—because who knew getting ready could lead to indoor camping? 🌧️
